language_selection.en:
The Brothers' Room

Welcome, brother.

My name is Tobi — I will be your guide through this course.

This is a free 6-week programme for men who want to understand gender-based violence, challenge harmful norms, and become real agents of change in their communities.

No judgment here. Na just us brothers talking honestly.

First things first — which language would you like to use?

start_welcome.en:
"Ekaabo!" (Welcome!) to the "{course_title}" course.

Here is a preview of the outline of what we will learn together:

*12 modules — 6 weeks · 2 modules per week · Mon & Thu*

*1*
*Understanding Gender & Masculinity*
Sex vs Gender · Power · Norms · Masculinity basics — Week 1, Monday

*2*
*Harmful Norms & Toxic Masculinity*
Gender norms · Patriarchy · Toxic masculinity · Real-life impact — Week 1, Thursday

*3*
*Introduction to SGBV*
What SGBV is · Types · Impacts on individuals and communities — Week 2, Monday

*4*
*Root Causes of SGBV*
Power imbalance · Culture · Economy · Socialisation — Week 2, Thursday

*5*
*Role of Men as Change Agents*
Challenging stereotypes · Allyship · Personal responsibility — Week 3, Monday

*6*
*Healthy Masculinity & Relationships*
Consent · Communication · Emotional intelligence — Week 3, Thursday

*7*
*Bystander Intervention*
Recognising abuse · Safe intervention · Supporting survivors — Week 4, Monday

*8*
*Peer Influence & Leadership*
Using influence positively · Advocacy · Becoming a role model — Week 4, Thursday

*9*
*Community Action & Advocacy*
Campaigns · Storytelling · Community engagement — Week 5, Monday

*10*
*Networks & Movement Building*
Young Men's Network · Collaboration · Sustainability — Week 5, Thursday

*11*
*Policy & Legal Awareness*
GBV laws · Rights · Reporting pathways in Nigeria — Week 6, Monday

*12*
*Personal Action Plan*
Commitment · Daily actions · Accountability · Public pledge — Week 6, Thursday

Let's start our journey. Click Next below to begin Module 1!
